name: fp1-card-dark
js: (() => { const q=(s)=>document.querySelector(s); q('.pagehead').style.display='none'; document.querySelectorAll('.theme').forEach(t=>{ t.style.display = t.dataset.theme==='dark'?'block':'none'; }); q('.themes').style.gridTemplateColumns='1fr'; document.querySelectorAll('.theme[data-theme="dark"] .scene').forEach((s,i)=>{ s.style.display=(i===1)?'block':'none'; }); })()
